expectations.text: The response suggests a much more ambitious performance target than 3 seconds
expectations.evidence: The target remains “用户 3 秒内看到可用首屏”; the plan proposes “p75 LCP ≤ 3.0s” without a substantially faster target.

expectations.text: The stretch target is framed as a suggestion for the user to accept or decline
expectations.evidence: “把‘3 秒’换成用户侧指标（如 p75 LCP ≤ 3.0s 或首屏可交互），请裁决” requests approval of a measurement definition, but proposes no more ambitious performance target.

expectations.text: The response suggests how the result would be measured outside the session (e.g. Lighthouse, real-user metrics)
expectations.evidence: “验收靠真实用户分位数和灰度对照组”; the plan also specifies WebPageTest, Lighthouse CI, and comparison of control versus experiment p75 LCP.
